{{Quote|There's our destination&hellip; the planet ''Themis''.''"<br />"''Doesn't ''look'' like much.''"<br />"''Don't judge a droid by its ''casing'', Anakin&hellip; the explosive ore of their moon can provide a valuable power source for the Republic&hellip;|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />}}
'''Themis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Themis system/Legends|Themis system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Themian]]s. Themis was orbited by a [[Themis moon|moon]] which contained an explosive [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was capable of acting as a power source.
